audit: Old source was a retailer (moresports.com), dropped; /size-guide on berghaus.com 404s, index at /pages/size-guides. Men's Jackets & Tops chart, body measurements, chest only (ranges, cm column used), XS-4XL. XS 87 -> 84-89; M 102 -> 99-104; XL 117 -> 114-120; 3XL 132 -> 129-135. 4XL added. Waist removed (not printed on this chart); UK/US/EU removed (not printed). Arm length not stored.
